title: Bot Map Auto-Coloring & Clearer Directional Clarifications
body:
- Added automatic bot map coloring for geographic questions (continents, regions, borders, coastlines, islands, hemispheres, and north/south/east/west coordinates): possible countries are shaded blue and ruled-out countries are shaded orange, while keeping your manual green/red markers on top.
- Added a toggle button on the map to hide or show bot coloring at any time, and a notice when a question cannot be auto-colored.
- Improved directional clarifications (north/south/east/west) to display the reference latitude or longitude line and explain that the target can lie anywhere along that side.
